title: 736. My Calendar I

examples.explanation: The middle booking overlaps [10,20) and fails; touching at 20 is fine.

hints: Keep accepted slots sorted by start (for example in an ordered map) so each booking only checks its neighbours.
A booking [s,e) clashes with a stored [a,b) exactly when max(s,a) < min(e,b).
Touching endpoints are fine: [10,20) and [20,30) do not overlap.
